httpd.description: HTTP server settings for CalDAV/CardDAV endpoints

httpd.listen.description: IP address to bind the HTTP listener to

httpd.port.description: Port to listen on for HTTP requests

httpd.servername.description: Public hostname used in redirects and headers

httpd.ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS for the HTTP endpoint

httpd.cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format)

httpd.key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format)

httpd.ca_file.description: Path to CA bundle for client cert verification (leave empty to disable)

dav.dbdir.description: Directory for storing CalDAV/CardDAV database files

dav.migrate.description: Enable migration from legacy DAV storage (run once, then disable)

dav.maxreqsize.description: Maximum HTTP request size (in bytes) — e.g., large iCalendar uploads

dav.default_timezone.description: Default timezone for calendars when none specified

dav.user_namespace.description: Expose user-specific calendars/addrbooks under their IMAP mailboxes (e.g., user/calendar)

dav.max_user_data_size.description: Maximum total calendar/addrbook data per user (in bytes)

dav.vcard_version.description: VCard version to use when exporting CardDAV records

dav.implicit_scheduling.description: Enable CalDAV implicit scheduling (automatic RSVP replies)

sasl.saslauthd_path.description: Path to saslauthd socket for password verification

sasl.mech_list.description: List of SASL mechanisms to allow (order matters for security)
